thread:
carla-eng: Hey @ben_s @dan_security — PR #4128 is ready for security review. It migrates the vault credential flow to ephemeral creds + envelope KMS encryption and touches the onprem agent auth and VPC peering config. Link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4128. Can we get a security review + merge decision? Targeting this week's merge window (Thu 09:00 PT).

ben_s: Quick skim — main concern is any silent fallback to static ENV secrets. Where are rotated creds stored and who can call Decrypt? Need explicit KMS policy and no implicit plaintext caching. :eyes:

carla-eng: Good call. Removed the static fallback and added an explicit error path if rotation fails. Diff excerpt: ```diff
- if envSecret != "" { return envSecret }
+ if envSecret != "" {
+   // deprecated: deny silent fallback
+   log.Error("static env secret fallback disabled")
+   return nil, errors.New("static secrets disabled")
+ }
```

dan_security: Noted. Two things: (1) onprem customers will need firewall/VPC peering changes documented, and (2) we need HSM/KMS key provenance documented for compliance. Also create a small threat model for the change. Ping @alice for rollout schedule impact. :lock:

secbot: [automated] SAST/secret-scan found 1 medium issue: potential hardcoded test key at infra/vault/agent/agent.go:45 — commented on PR.

ben_s: Running integration tests locally now. If the secret-scan hit is test-only, please remove before merge or mark as FP with a comment. I can re-review tomorrow morning and then approve if CI + sec checks pass.

alice: FYI — if security signoff isn't complete by Wed EOD we should postpone this week's merge window. Thursday is tight given release cutover. :clock3:

carla-eng: Understood. I'll address secbot finding and add the minimal KMS policy example in the PR description: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh"}]}
```

dan_security: Also add a privacy-review checklist entry and a simple dataflow diagram (agent -> vault -> KMS -> token consumer). Ensure logs redact token fields and show an example redact rule. :clipboard:

ben_s: Left a few code nits and one test suggestion on the PR. Everything looks small. I can give LGTM after CI and secbot are green. :thumbsup:

carla-eng: Thanks — replying to comments now. @dan_security would appreciate your approval once CI + secbot clear; I'll queue for Thursday merge window if we get that.

secbot: [automated] CI build: ✅ all tests passed. Secret-scan: ✅ cleared after update. No open security checks.
